teacher_result_binding: Unique integer input index, original request fingerprint, unique nonempty operation_id, completed status, consistent finite label and acceptance fields
held_request_canonical: json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode(); no newline
teacher_request_canonical: json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode(); UTF-8; no newline
unknown_scoring: Separate from correct or rejected; blocks gate. Unknown OOD is never credited as rejection.
evaluator_access: No teacher prompt/source/output read while writing evaluator; field schema and canonical function only supplied by parent. No previous held query text read.
baseline_control: Original frozen V6, V5 and deterministic parser; no training/calibration/code changes. Frozen files verified before and after.
costs: Count provider usage when present, including failed or invalid attempts; missing usage remains unknown. Router child wall and CPU only, no system-wide memory claim.
baseline_exit_code: 0 means all three evaluation streams are valid; each semantic gate outcome remains explicit in SUMMARY.json. 1 means a protocol/unknown failure.
teacher_exit_code: 0 only if its entire preregistered qualification gate passes; otherwise 1.
limitations: Independently authored by a separate assistant, not human/user/business samples.
Exact public-language deduplication does not establish semantic independence.
Oracle rows are only used in scorer checks, never as measured candidate evidence.
